user.title: GreenUtilityLog
user.description:
Send your meter reading automatically, so you never photograph the meter again.

Get your token in the app: Submit → Have a P1 reader? → Automatic setup → “Get my device token”. Do one photo submission first — that sets your starting point.

data_description.source_entity: The sensor whose value keeps counting up — your meter total, not current power.
data_description.ingest_url: Leave as-is unless you run your own backend.

error.token_required: Paste the device token from the app.
error.entity_not_found: That entity doesn't exist (any more). Pick another.
error.entity_not_numeric: That entity has no numeric value. Pick your cumulative meter total.
error.entity_not_kwh: That entity isn't in kWh. Pick the total meter reading, not current power.

abort.already_configured: This meter is already being sent.
